patch_description: Replace the two unrelated Gaussian starts with a more targeted basin-coverage portfolio around the strong staggered-hexagon family. Each geometric parameterization now receives both a fine perturbation, which preserves its favorable contact graph, and a larger deterministic perturbation, which can change near-contact assignments and enter nearby asymmetric basins. This uses optimization effort on configurations already known to be competitive rather than on low-probability random layouts, while retaining the independent cube-plus-axis basin.
